```sql
SELECT
    batter,
    SUM(runs) AS total_runs,
    SUM(fours) * 4 + SUM(sixes) * 6 AS boundary_runs,
    ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(fours) * 4 + SUM(sixes) * 6) / NULLIF(SUM(runs), 0), 2) AS boundary_share_percent
FROM batting_by_season
GROUP BY batter
HAVING SUM(runs) >= 1000
ORDER BY boundary_share_percent DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
